concepts.gloss_en: Cherut — freedom/liberty (as in ben chorin, freedom of the covenant)

members.note: representative; freedom/liberty, tied to ben chorin and brit
same noun חרות with clitic preposition ל ('to freedom'); prefix does not change the referent

concepts.gloss_en: Shacharut — blackness (of the eye) / dawn-quality; the lower intellect that contracts and delimits, linked to Avraham establishing shacharit

members.note: distinct root (שחר/שחור, blackness/dawn); about the black of the eye and morning — semantically unrelated to freedom despite surface similarity

notes: The mechanical 'clitic/plural' signal is misleading: שחרות is NOT חרות with a ש-clitic — it derives from a different root (blackness/dawn) and is a separate concept. Only לחרות is a genuine clitic form of חרות. Kept the two roots strictly separate per under-merge rule.
